FX-AWAVE-001.says: The settings as they start, no Audio Layer: silence, so a flat Analog Line 2 thick along the line through the middle, alone.

FX-AWAVE-002.says: Eight displayed samples of a 10 ms window, 4 tall each way at most, Analog Lines, 2 thick, sharp, alone: a zigzag across the middle, each point the least or greatest of its six source samples as Random Seed 1 picks.

FX-AWAVE-003.says: FX-AWAVE-002 with Composite On Original on: added to the cel.

FX-AWAVE-004.says: Digital: each displayed sample a stroke from its least to its greatest source sample.

FX-AWAVE-005.says: Analog Dots: a dot at each picked point.

FX-AWAVE-006.says: Random Seed 2: other picks of least or greatest.

FX-AWAVE-007.says: Random Seed 2.9: its whole part counted, so FX-AWAVE-006's frame.

FX-AWAVE-008.says: The stereo file, Waveform Options Left: the 600 Hz channel alone.

FX-AWAVE-009.says: The stereo file, Right: the 900 Hz channel alone.

FX-AWAVE-010.says: The stereo file, Mono: the two channels' mean.

FX-AWAVE-011.says: The one-channel file with Right: it plays as Mono, so FX-AWAVE-002's frame.

FX-AWAVE-012.says: Audio Offset 5 ms: the window starts 24 samples later.

FX-AWAVE-013.says: Audio Duration 40 ms: 192 samples, 24 to each displayed sample, so every least and greatest is near the tone's own.

FX-AWAVE-014.says: Displayed Samples 1: one point in the middle of the line, a dot.

FX-AWAVE-015.says: Displayed Samples 48: one source sample each, the wave itself.

FX-AWAVE-016.says: Digital with Displayed Samples 60, more than the window's 48: some displayed samples share a source sample.

FX-AWAVE-017.says: Path 1, a mask (mode None) round the box from (2, 2) to (14, 8), 16 displayed samples, 2 tall at most: a closed line round the box.

FX-AWAVE-018.says: Path 2 with only one mask: none to draw along, so nothing is drawn and EFFECT_PATH_MISSING is said; the cel as it was.

FX-AWAVE-019.says: Audio Layer "ghost", not in the composition: EFFECT_LAYER_MISSING is said and the cel is as it was.

FX-AWAVE-020.says: Audio Layer "art", the cel itself, which holds no sound: EFFECT_SOUND_MISSING is said and the cel is as it was.

FX-AWAVE-021.says: The 24-bit file: as FX-AWAVE-002 within a level.

FX-AWAVE-024.says: The sound layer starting at frame 2: frames 0 and 1 silent (a flat line), frame 4 its own frame 2.

FX-AWAVE-025.says: The sound layer at -6.0206 dB, half as loud: the wave half as tall.

FX-AWAVE-026.says: The sound layer at +12 dB: four times as loud, held to Maximum Height.

FX-AWAVE-027.says: Maximum Height keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 4 at frame 4, linear.

FX-AWAVE-028.says: FX-AWAVE-002 moved three pixels right: the wave moves with the layer.

FX-AWAVE-029.says: After a Motion Tile that grows the layer: the points are the drawing's own, so the frame is FX-AWAVE-002's.

FX-AWAVE-030.says: Thickness 0: nothing drawn, the cel as it was.

FX-AWAVE-031.says: Thickness 3, softness 100, orange inside, violet outside.

FX-AWAVE-032.says: Start Point (90, 50), End Point (10, 50): drawn right to left, so the wave faces down.

FX-AWAVE-034.says: Displayed Samples 0, below 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-AWAVE-035.says: Displayed Samples 4097, above 4096. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-AWAVE-036.says: Maximum Height -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-AWAVE-037.says: Audio Duration 0, below 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-AWAVE-038.says: Audio Offset -30001, below -30000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-AWAVE-039.says: Thickness -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-AWAVE-040.says: Softness 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-AWAVE-041.says: Random Seed -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-AWAVE-042.says: Path 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-AWAVE-043.says: End Point -1001 per cent down, below -1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-AWAVE-044.says: Waveform Options "stereo", not mono, left or right. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-AWAVE-045.says: Display Options "bars", not digital, analog_lines or analog_dots. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-AWAVE-046.says: Composite "yes", not on or off. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-AWAVE-047.says: Outside colour "blue", not #rrggbb. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-AWAVE-048.says: Audio Layer 5, a number, not a layer's name. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-AWAVE-049.says: Displayed Samples keyed to 4097 at frame 4, above 4096. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
